dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, crenulated perimeters consisting of high-intensity light pixels forming semi-closed 'C' and closed 'O' shapes. The gradient transition is sharp from the dark exterior coat to the light boundary, with the interior of the shapes returning to the dark base intensity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid, high-intensity white-grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the interstitial spaces between larger annuli and along the lower lateral margins.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the upper dorsal quadrant form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary chain of smaller high-intensity blobs forms a curved linear relationship following the contour of the lower spinal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-saturation linear orange-red mark is visible on the distal edge of the right hind flipper, accompanied by several smaller high-saturation red punctate marks along the lateral pelvic-flipper junction.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex reticulated network where multiple macro-annuli merge into a continuous high-contrast mesh-like pattern across the mid-dorsal surface.
